cases.title: [Bug]: CLONE does not preserve AUTO_INCREMENT state
cases.evidence: Issue and reporter follow-ups reproduce continuation divergence for table/database CLONE, empty clone, and DATA BRANCH; issue is assigned and severity/s0.

cases.title: [Bug]: DATA BRANCH from a snapshot links children to a recreated same-name table
cases.evidence: Merged fix preserves snapshot parent identity; upstream QA plus black-box and white-box regressions verify historical IDs and downstream DIFF.

cases.title: [DocDB] Create table fails in cloned database [oid collision issue]
cases.evidence: Issue explicitly validates cloned DB objects and data before later DML/DDL/create-object continuation fails; labels include high priority and GA/2026.1 blockers.

cases.title: [DocDB] clone: Regression to cloning a DB with a vector index
cases.evidence: Issue attributes clone-time PREPARING state to restart-triggered AddTableToTablet and tserver crash loops; closed/not_planned must not be represented as fixed.

cases.title: Attempting to drop a database which was created with `dolt_clone` fails.
cases.evidence: Maintainer root-cause comment identifies divergent DatabaseProvider create/clone state; merged PR #7107 explicitly fixes #7106.

cases.title: prev_record_lsn for branching with old lsn
cases.evidence: Issue reproduces old-LSN branch metadata with newer prev_record_lsn and compute startup PANIC; discussion explains missing previous-WAL-record knowledge at historical branch boundary.

cases.title: DbReader cannot read a zero-copy clone: external (parent-resident) SSTs are resolved under the clone's own root
cases.evidence: Initial issue closure was due to unreviewed agent filing; maintainer independently found the defect; merged PR #1907 adds normal and checkpoint-pinned DbReader clone regression tests.
